scope: Paired offline decision ablation on authored development/engineering references, not blind or representative real-user accuracy.
wordLM: Remove trained n-gram scores, OOV penalty, empirical context corrections/evidence and legacy fallback. Keep source vocabulary, morphology, lexical constraints and candidate retrieval fixed. This measures WordLM probabilistic/contextual decisions, not its entire lexical-data contribution.
charSpell: Omit the learned character scorer in both baseline and PunctCase stability verification. Keep candidates/linguistic constraints fixed.
punctCase: Omit only the automatic PunctCase proposal and acceptance/stability stage.
baseline: All older models, reviewed rules, dictionary, source vocabulary and formatting remain. w0c0p0 is not a model-free or regex-only baseline.
interactions: Benefits are conditional on the other components. Leave-one-out, standalone-on-fixed-baseline and Shapley attribution are different quantities.
latency: Corpus timings share CPU and caches; isolated warm benchmark is reported separately. No latency claims from concurrent corpus timing.
limitations: Static source vocabulary and older learned models remain in every configuration.
WordLM final document monitoring remains present even in score ablations; this is not a memory/load-removal benchmark.
Authored/development references include repeated structures and overlaps. Report datasets separately; do not interpret aggregate match rate as real-user accuracy.
Exact reference matching can reject legitimate stylistic alternatives.
No neural training or threshold selection used these results.

wordLMDecisionSourceRemoval.scope: Additional WordLM learned-data ablation: remove trained probability/context decisions and only the trained vocabulary words supplied to lexical-evidence. All lexical helper function bodies, their dictionary-based repairs, general morphology, CharSpell, PunctCase and older rules/models remain. Final WordLM document monitoring remains and cannot affect output. Distinct from the eight-way fixed-lexicon score ablation.

remainingErrorDiagnosis.scope: Actual-output-equivalent trace of remaining500-case engineering errors. Expanded retrieval/scoring is an offline counterfactual, not an app improvement or fitted policy. Expected target is never injected into the generated candidate pool.

targetLexiconCoverage.scope: Existing frozen target availability; does not add targets to runtime vocabulary or fit a policy.

retrievalPrototype.scope: Post-audit diagnostic on observed engineering failures, not blind evaluation or a deployed improvement. No expected target is injected into retrieval. No model weights/policies/app source change.
retrievalPrototype.policy: Existing WordLM vocabulary indexed by folded word. One deletion, insertion, substitution or adjacent swap. Order by existing source unigram then lexical order, retain raw/current, cap20. Use existing app OOV/context/channel weights and CharSpell fusion weight without refitting. Character/LM/fused ranks are diagnostic; app protection and acceptance guards are not applied.

punctCaseGapDiagnosis.scope: Diagnostic missing/wrong punctuation gaps in frozen40 contrast cases; probabilities are not calibrated real-user confidence and do not justify lowering thresholds.
